name: Delegate
description: Hand work to a swarm agent for tunnel/SSH hosts, specialty implementation, or parallel swarm tasks.

function.name: delegate
function.description: Hand off to another session member. Use when (1) work is on a tunnel/SSH workplace owned by them, (2) implementation matches their role (ops/research/coding/…), (3) you want a parallel swarm, or (4) the user @mentioned them. Coordinator Tomo handles local-install work; remote/specialty → delegate. After success the target runs immediately.

name.description: Target agent display name (alternative to agent_id).

reason.description: Full brief: goal, workplace id/name/host, paths, constraints, prior findings. Never a one-word reason.
